comparison.objective: Build two scaffold footings on lawn using a sole board and base plates, then stand tubes.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequentially place a load-spreading board, plates, and tubes with axial seating.
comparison.success_condition: Correct support stack and upright tubes; direct placement on grass irreversibly fails.
comparison.reason: Although tubes enter collars, the tested ability is ordered footing construction and load distribution, not tool-driven notch fracture or released-fragment recovery.
